notes:
• New 🧾 Tickets tab: a board of every buy / trade customer (Waiting → Scanning → Pricing → Offer ready → Accepted → Done), searchable by name, phone, email or ticket number. ＋ New ticket for walk-ins
• Click a ticket to see everything under that customer and ticket number: contact info, what they brought, the offer (cash / credit / e-gift, accepted, signed, in Square, gift card), and a timeline of every step (CSV loaded, sent to CardUploader, shown on the iPad, signed, uploaded to Square, notes). Start, open the offer, show it on the iPad, move it along, cancel or mark done from there
• Tell the customer: ready-made messages (Got your ticket / Working on it / Offer ready with the amounts / Thank you / Ready to pick up) — email them or copy for a text. Every message includes a link to the customer's own status page that updates by itself
• While working an offer, a bar at the top shows the ticket number, customer and stage
